- A Texas judge upheld a nuclear verdict against C.H. Robinson, reinforcing severe liability risks that drive up reinsurance costs and necessitate strict telematics underwriting for fleets [1].
- Allstate's Arity acquired traffic data pioneer Inrix after two decades, bolstering Arity's telematics capabilities and increasing competitive pressure on proprietary fleet analytics platforms [2].
- Bronx Amazon delivery contractors warned that a local bill puts jobs and operating models at risk, signaling that monitoring regulatory pressure on contractor liability is vital for managing commercial auto exposures [3].
- Parcel shipping costs hit record highs as fuel surcharges decoupled from diesel prices, translating into stronger fleet budgets for premium telematics-based risk management solutions [4].
- Lyft agreed to a $272 million settlement over driver compensation and classification in California, highlighting ongoing labor risks that can impact last-mile fleet structures and insurance risk profiles [5].
